import json
import torch
from torch.utils.data import BatchSampler, DataLoader

groups = list(BatchSampler(range(10), 3, False))
identity = list(DataLoader(list(range(10)), batch_sampler=groups, collate_fn=list))
nonidentity = list(DataLoader(list(range(10, 20)), batch_sampler=groups, collate_fn=list))
assert identity == groups and nonidentity != groups
print(json.dumps({
    "torch_commit": torch.version.git_version,
    "grouped_indices": groups,
    "identity_values": identity,
    "offset_values": nonidentity,
}))
